entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: A person with shoulder-length reddish-brown hair worn half-up, dressed in a light pink long-sleeved short dress outfit, and carrying a yellow hard-shell suitcase.

entities.name: yellow hard-shell suitcase
entities.identification: The yellow rectangular hard-shell suitcase beside Person B's leg, with rounded corners, a light-colored handle on top, and metal connectors.

entities.name: black binoculars
entities.identification: The binoculars hanging in front of Person B's chest and abdomen, appearing mainly as a black tubular silhouette in side view.

entities.name: brown woven crossbody bag
entities.identification: The brown basket-like crossbody bag at Person B's waist, with a dark curved edge, vertical strip weaving, and a rectangular lattice section.

entities.name: golden-yellow grassland
entities.identification: The tall golden-yellow grass occupying the foreground and middle ground, with a flattened grassy path nearby and upright dark green weeds interspersed throughout.

entities.name: distant band of dark green trees
entities.identification: The band of dark green trees and shrubs extending horizontally across the background, with an undulating canopy.

entities.name: distant wind turbine with slender blades
entities.identification: The distant wind turbine visible above the band of trees, with slender support rods and a circular, radially arranged rotor.

entities.name: light-colored sky
entities.identification: The sky above the band of trees, overall warm and light-colored, with faint, thin clouds.

entities.name: blue tote bag
entities.identification: The blue tote bag carried beside Person B's leg; in the first frame of this clip, it is occluded by the yellow hard-shell suitcase and Person B, with only a blue portion exposed.
